==Usage==
<nowiki>{{EquipmentProgressionTable|Class|Type}}</nowiki>

===Fields===
*Type:
**''Each item is grouped into several categories, listed below''
***Guerilla
***Smuggler
***Bodyguard
***Enforcer
**'''''Special exceptions, with only two tiers:'''''
***Hutt Guard (Only Damaged, <Blank>)
***Survivalist (Only Damaged, <Blank>)
***Scavenger (Only Damaged, <Blank>)
***Street Punk (Only Damaged, <Blank>)

*Class:
**''Examples include Shirt, Dungarees, Trousers, etc - each Type has its own suffix (e.g., Smuggler Dungarees) that has to be manually sourced based on Type and Slot.''

*Quality 1, Quality 2, Quality 3:
**'''For reference only - now built into template'''
**''Each item comes in a progression of three (e.g., Stock, Altered, Revised) which corresponds to its Star Rating and Max Level. 
***Weathered, Patched, Refined
***Stock, Altered, Revised
***Standard, Refitted, Perfect
**'''Exception: First tier gear, which only comes in two forms: Damaged and <Blank> (no Prefix). First tier gear is limited to special Types listed above.'''''
***Damaged, <Blank>
